name: Pokémon FireRed Reignited
summary: Pokémon FireRed Reignited is a fan-made ROM hack of Pokémon FireRed, developed by Bruhcation as an unofficial continuation of TheSmithPlays' Legacy series. Inspired by the design philosophy of those ROM hacks, the project aims to improve and rebalance the classic Game Boy Advance adventure by addressing long-standing flaws, updating wild encounters and trainer teams, and adding quality-of-life features while keeping the authentic feel of Kanto intact.
